t: You're looking at St Yeghiche, the largest church of the Armenian Apostolic Church in Great Britain. It faces Cranley Gardens in South Kensington. It was built privately in 1867 as St Peter's, an Anglican church, by the developer Charles James Freake, whose widow later lived in one of the neighbouring houses. It went on to become the Church of England parish church of Kensington. The original dedication was to Saint Peter, the apostle and one of the first leaders of the early Christian Church, which is where the building got its first name.
